title: Example smoke (runner reference suite)
notes: The reference suite: copy this file and scripts/bench/suites/example-smoke.mjs when adding a benchmark. It needs no database, no key and no browser, so it exercises the runner end to end on every machine and in every CI job. Deliberately watch tier — it measures the shared percentile helper, not a product promise, so it must never be the reason a PR is red. See docs/runbooks/benchmarks.md.
